purpose: Teach: 琉球/盛岡/大宮/八王子/ケンブリッジ/シベリア/サンパウロ/平壌

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、琉球料理がご趣味だって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, I heard the customer has a real fondness for Ryukyuan cuisine.
lines.style: Soft, observant tone. Gentle certainty without insistence. Speaking as though sharing something noticed and held gently. Even pace, warm regard underneath.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、盛岡冷麺がお気に入りだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, I heard the customer is fond of Morioka cold noodles.
lines.style: Similar warmth as before. A quiet smile in the voice. Sharing observations like small, precious details. Unhurried, tender in the noticing.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、大宮の鉄道博物館にお詳しいって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, I heard the customer knows quite a bit about the Omiya Railway Museum.
lines.style: Gentle curiosity beneath the surface. Noticing something specific and particular about this person. Warm, almost conspiratorial—like sharing a secret about them.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、八王子に新しい支店ができたって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, I heard they're opening a new branch in Hachioji.
lines.style: Softer shift in focus. Still observant, but now extending outward to what the customer knows or mentioned. Thoughtful, unhurried delivery.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ケンブリッジ大学に留学経験がおありだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, I heard the customer studied abroad at Cambridge.
lines.style: Slight lift of genuine interest. Noticing something substantial about them—a real experience, a real journey. Warm without performing enthusiasm. Steady pace.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、シベリア鉄道の旅行記がご趣味だって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, I heard the customer enjoys reading travel journals about the Trans-Siberian Railway.
lines.style: Deeper warmth now. Noting something specific that reveals the person's inner world. Quiet admiration in the tone. Unhurried, almost reverent in the noticing.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、サンパウロのカーニバルを観てこられたって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, I heard the customer has actually seen the carnival in São Paulo.
lines.style: Genuine wonder beneath composure. This detail feels significant—a real experience, a real journey witnessed. Voice opens slightly with admiration. Warm, wondering.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、平壌のニュースに関心がおありだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, I heard the customer takes an interest in news from Pyongyang.
lines.style: Slight pause before continuing. Noting something more particular, more inward about this person. Respectful curiosity. Warm close, fading softly at the end.
